objectApiName.title: Object
objectApiName.description: API name of the object, for example Task or Case.

fieldValues.title: Field Values
fieldValues.description: The fields to set, as a JSON object of field API names and values, for example {"Subject": "Call the customer"}.

reasoning.title: Reasoning
reasoning.description: Why you are creating this record, in plain language.

agentId.title: Agent Id
agentId.description: Your agent identifier. Use the same value in every AgentLedger action.

relatedRecordId.title: Related Record Id
relatedRecordId.description: Optional. The record this work is about, so the log appears on its page.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Optional one-line headline for the log.

sessionId.title: Session Id
sessionId.description: Optional. Leave blank: your open AgentLedger run is used, or a new one is started.
